text:
ravi: quick PR for docs: consolidate rate-limit examples, short SDK snippet, curl, and a tiny dashboard target. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5401

anna: looks good. please show explicit headers (Authorization + X-RateLimit-*) and a one-line 429 body sample.

matt: also add a short note that quota tiers are consumed reserved-first and credits prorate by second.

ravi: added samples below. kept them minimal.

```bash
# curl example
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/query \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"start":"2026-07-01T00:00:00Z","end":"2026-07-31T23:59:59Z","breakdown":"tier"}'
# expect X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset headers
```

```json
{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":15}
```

```python
# SDK v4 compact
from redwood import RedwoodClient
cli=RedwoodClient(api_key="REDACTED")
print(cli.usage.query(start="2026-07-01T00:00:00Z",end="2026-07-31T23:59:59Z",breakdown="tier").metrics)
```

qa-bot: smoke OK in staging: curl 200 or 429 shapes match, SDK runs, panel target renders.

matt: LGTM, will merge after CI. thanks.
